subject: Patti Fernandez cannot connect to AVD (AADSTS53003) and RDP 3389 looks open on the host pool
description: Patti Fernandez (Accounts Payable) gets a Conditional Access block when opening the Windows App against vdpool-contoso-fin-01 since 06:04 UTC today; the dialog shows AADSTS53003 with correlation id 44c6f95f-dc66-4c51-984b-020fda4523b2. The user was moved to the Microsoft 365 E5 bundle last week but still appears on E3. While checking nsg-contoso-avd-hostpool-01 a vendor rule allowing RDP 3389 from the internet is visible in the portal and is not in our Terraform.
